intent: Document and validate the six additional Horizon foundation tokens, their source values, semantics and CSS distribution.

tokens.name: --sl-radius-4
tokens.reason: Large rounded surfaces requiring the 1.5rem radius from the design reference.

tokens.name: --sl-font-weight-bold
tokens.reason: A 700 weight for emphasis stronger than semibold.

tokens.name: --sl-shadow-3
tokens.reason: An intermediate elevation shadow for raised surfaces.

tokens.name: --sl-shadow-4
tokens.reason: A composed elevation shadow with separate near and far layers.

tokens.name: --sl-shadow-5
tokens.reason: An additional surface shadow with stronger opacity.

tokens.name: --sl-overlay-bg
tokens.reason: A reusable overlay background distinct from product layout or stacking rules.

impact.summary: Horizon exposes six additional token names and selects foundation values for radii, palettes, muted colors, weights and shadows. A token declaration does not by itself change a component to consume that token.
impact.consumerAction: Import Horizon tokens or the complete Horizon stylesheet before using these names. Choose tokens by the semantic purpose approved with design.

openQuestions: Which reusable component surfaces should consume the added elevation and overlay tokens?

evidence.description: Verify declarations, aliases, referenced values and the six names against the pinned source.
Build CSS and verify complete and token-only layered/unlayered exports.
Review token swatches and representative surfaces using the proposed values.
Measure contrast and focus visibility in the intended foreground/background combinations.
